names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 iunie, «Sfânta Muceniță Valeria».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Ιουνίου, «Αγια Βαρερια η Παρθενα», with the rank word left off. The day's line gives the second form beside it, «Βαρέρια (ή Βαλερία)», which is the one the folder's English name follows.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 iunie — «Sfânta Muceniță Valeria»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουνίου — «Αγίες πέντε Παρθένες, Μάρθα, Μαρία, Κυρία, Βαρέρια και Μαρκία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and carries all five virgins on one page with a head line for each. The day's line gives this one two forms, «Βαρέρια (ή Βαλερία)», and the head line uses the first: «Αγια Βαρερια η Παρθενα». The other four of the five have no folder in the corpus and are drafted new in `el-06-06`. The page gives no year, no emperor and no judge's name, so the folder's dateless reading stands. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
